status: bounded primary-literature audit complete; weighted-tree algebraic audit passed internally; novelty and external review remain open

claims.statement: For every finite d>=2 and every unital, trace-preserving, Hilbert-Schmidt-selfadjoint CPTP Phi:M_d->M_d with a supplied two-output CPTP broadcaster whose two marginals are Phi, there exists one canonical measure-and-prepare CPTP map Psi such that I-Psi <= 2*ceil(log2(d^2-1))*(I-Phi) in positive-operator order on the real Hilbert-Schmidt space of Hermitian matrices.
assumptions: Phi is HS-selfadjoint but need not be positive as an HS operator
claims.status: internal proof candidate; key interface and order steps rechecked; independent proof review and priority clearance open
claims.novelty_boundary: Inspected compatibility/incompatibility-breaking work gives joint measurability and antidegradability characterizations; finite-copy approximate-broadcasting work gives dimension-dependent absolute diamond error. No inspected primary source states this relative EB Loewner/Dirichlet comparison. Bounded search only; no historical priority claim.
claims.costs: For s=d^2-1 test directions, K=2^ceil(log2 s)<2s output receivers and K-1 broadcaster uses. The explicit raw product POVM can have d^K outcomes. An exact canonical POVM with at most (d^4+3d^2)/2+1 effects exists by a lifted-moment Caratheodory argument, but the comparator is existential and no efficient solver, finite-precision stability, channel tomography, or physical calibration protocol is given.
claims.falsifier: Find a positive HS frame Q for which every canonical measurement map has Tr_HS[Q(Psi-(I-2m(I-Phi)))]<0, or identify an error in tree marginalization, score refinement, spectral inequality, compact-convex representation, or cone separation.
claims.next_gate: The equal-depth and weighted-tree proofs have passed this internal audit; seek an external proof review and test whether the effective-entropy family criterion yields a useful acquisition result.

claims.statement: For any fixed real s-dimensional Hermitian test subspace V, the same assumptions give one canonical EB map Psi_V with <A,(I-Psi_V)A>_tau <= 2*ceil(log2 s)*<A,(I-Phi)A>_tau for every A in V; if a frame can be partitioned into q commuting classes, q may replace its rank in the tree depth.
assumptions: V is fixed before the minimax/separation step
claims.status: internal corollary of the tree proof
claims.novelty_boundary: Restricted comparison follows the same finite-frame proof. Commuting classes share one common eigenbasis measurement. A restricted comparator need not satisfy the operator inequality outside V; no uniform comparator over varying subspaces is claimed.
claims.costs: K<2s leaves, or K<2q for a frame with q commuting classes; each tree uses K-1 broadcaster calls. State-family samples and acquisition are not included.
claims.falsifier: A positive witness supported on V violates the restricted score inequality or the commuting-frame grouping does not preserve the local spectral score.
claims.next_gate: Use exact commuting-context reuse where available; quantify approximate context covers only with explicit HS and family-size dependence.

claims.statement: For bounded tracial likelihoods rho_H=(I+H)/d with H in an s-dimensional real test subspace V, ||H||_infinity<=theta<1, and r_V=sup_H ||Phi(H)-H||_(1,tau), the restricted comparator satisfies sup_H 1/2||Psi_V(rho_H)-rho_H||_1 <= 1/2*sqrt(2*ceil(log2 s)*theta*r_V).
assumptions: the family is tracial and bounded in operator norm
claims.novelty_boundary: This is static reconstruction of a specified bounded family, not diamond-norm channel approximation, arbitrary-state approximation, ancilla preservation, or a general bounded-Holevo implication.
claims.costs: Inherits K<2s receivers and K-1 broadcaster uses for an explicit frame witness; no sample complexity for learning/implementing Psi is supplied.
claims.falsifier: A counterexample to the restricted Dirichlet order, (I-Psi_V)^2<=I-Psi_V, or the normalized trace/Schatten conversion.
claims.next_gate: Build a finite-precision implementation for an acquired low-dimensional family and compare its total channel/sample cost against an equally informed direct tomography baseline.

claims.statement: If Phi is unital, trace-preserving and HS-selfadjoint with spectral gap gamma>0 on traceless Hermitian operators, the canonical depolarizing EB channel Delta(X)=tau(X)I satisfies I-Delta <= gamma^(-1)(I-Phi).
assumptions: gamma is the lower spectral bound of I-Phi on the traceless subspace
claims.status: direct spectral-gap derivation; does not require self-compatibility
claims.novelty_boundary: This is the ordinary Poincare/spectral-gap inequality with a depolarizing EB map. It can outperform the tree when gamma^(-1)<2*ceil(log2(d^2-1)); it says nothing useful for an arbitrarily slow nontrivial mode.
claims.costs: No tree or extra channel uses are required once the gap is known. Acquiring/certifying gamma is an external model-analysis or estimation cost not covered here.
claims.falsifier: An eigenvalue of Phi on the traceless subspace violates the stated lower bound gamma.
claims.next_gate: For a target family, estimate a restricted gap gamma_V and compare 1/gamma_V against the tree rank factor.

claims.statement: If a unital trace-preserving HS-selfadjoint channel Phi has finite EB index n, then the general EB comparator Psi=Phi^n satisfies I-Psi <= n(I-Phi).
claims.status: direct functional-calculus corollary; comparator need not be canonical
claims.novelty_boundary: Park's 2026 preprint proves finite EB index for PPT maps and n<=3 on its PPT DSP2 subclass. PPT/finite-index assumptions are not implied by self-compatibility, so this is a restricted stronger bound, not a resolution of the tree theorem's full interface.
claims.costs: The comparator requires n sequential uses of Phi if physically implemented; the value n may be unknown or large for the general PPT theorem. This bound does not construct a canonical same-effects measurement channel.
claims.falsifier: A scalar eigenvalue lambda in [-1,1] violates 1-lambda^n<=n(1-lambda), or Phi^n is not EB under the stated finite-index assumption.
claims.next_gate: Identify self-compatible models with explicit finite EB index and compare n to the logarithmic tree bound.

claims.statement: If an invariant s-dimensional traceless observable subspace has spectrum(Phi|V) subset [1-eta,1], one tree comparator preserves every bounded likelihood state rho_A=(I+A)/d on V to half trace error at most (theta/2)*sqrt(2*ceil(log2 s)*eta), for ||A||_infinity<=theta<1.
assumptions: V is Phi-invariant and contains only slow eigenmodes with eigenvalue at least 1-eta
claims.novelty_boundary: A static state-family reconstruction theorem. It does not simulate controlled transitions, preserve correlations with an external reference, or establish physical metastability absent the model assumptions.
claims.costs: K<2s receivers and K-1 exact broadcaster uses for frame construction; no state preparation data, model identification, calibration, or empirical error bars are included.
claims.falsifier: A mode in V has Dirichlet energy above eta||A||_2^2 or the restricted tree comparator fails its quadratic order.
claims.next_gate: Apply to a supplied antidegradable detailed-balance model with acquired slow-mode subspace; charge mode estimation and apparatus implementation.

claims.statement: For the stated finite-dimensional unital, trace-preserving, HS-selfadjoint self-compatible channel, the C4-Q3 weighted-tree proof correctly establishes one common canonical EB comparator with I-Psi <= 2G[ I+log2(Tr_HS(G)/G) ] on the traceless HS space, with zero value at zero gaps. The all-PSD congruence, Jensen sign, Kraft code, score refinement, positive-cone separation, and epsilon limit pass an independent internal audit.
assumptions: HS-selfadjoint Phi; HS positivity is not assumed
claims.status: independent internal proof audit passed; mathematical external review and novelty clearance remain open
claims.novelty_boundary: No inspected primary source states the same common canonical EB relative Dirichlet profile. Bounded search only. This profile does not uniformly dominate the equal-depth logarithmic bound, and the C4 factor-2 conjecture and N93 bounded-Holevo lift remain unresolved.
claims.costs: The fixed-comparator separation can be restricted to the compact convex hull of product-PVM tree strategies with at most d^2-1 real leaves. Each component uses at most d^2-2 broadcaster calls and at most d^2-1 receivers; a finite mixture of at most d^2(d^2+1)/2+1 components exists. The mixture is nonconstructive and raw outcomes can be exponential in d^2.
claims.falsifier: A counterexample to the all-PSD support inequality or any failure of the audited code, score, separation, or zero-gap limit steps.
claims.next_gate: Independent external proof review, and a dual-frame lower bound or measurement-reuse theorem that decides whether the logarithmic loss is necessary.

claims.statement: For a finite tracial likelihood family rho_x=(I+H_x)/d with ||H_x||_infinity<=theta and residual max_x||Phi(H_x)-H_x||_(1,tau)<=r, define Q_p=sum_x p_x |H_x><H_x|, E_p=Tr_HS(Q_p G), and R_p=G^(1/2)Q_p G^(1/2). When E_p>0 set sigma_p=R_p/E_p and L_p=min{ceil(log2(rank Q_p)), 1+S_2(sigma_p)}; set E_p L_p=0 at E_p=0. Then one common canonical EB map exists with max_x physical half-trace reconstruction error <= sqrt((1/2) sup_p E_p L_p) <= sqrt(theta*r*(sup_p L_p)/2).
assumptions: finite family of tracial bounded likelihood states
all priors are included in the supremum
Sion minimax applied to convex squared HS reconstruction loss
claims.status: internally derived consequence; proof uses the Q-dependent Huffman/pruned-tree bound plus compact-convex minimax; not externally reviewed
claims.novelty_boundary: This supplies a sufficient uniform reconstruction condition when worst-prior energy-weighted effective entropy is bounded. It does not follow from bounded Holevo capacity alone and does not solve N93 without controlling that entropy or another collective-measurement statistic.
claims.costs: For each prior-specific dual witness of rank k, a Huffman or near-balanced full tree uses k-1 broadcaster calls, k receivers, and at most d^k raw PVM outcomes. The common minimax comparator is existential; a finite mixture has at most d^2(d^2+1)/2+1 tree components, each of cost at most d^2-2 calls. State samples, channel tomography, finite precision and compilation are uncharged.
claims.falsifier: A counterexample to the per-prior score bound, the contraction inequality (I-Psi)^2<=I-Psi, or the convex minimax step.
claims.next_gate: Identify experimentally meaningful families for which sup_p L_p stays small as d and label count grow, then compare the resulting common EB acquisition cost to N93 controls.

claims.statement: If a finite tested family of Hermitian observables is covered by q commuting contexts, measuring one common spectral PVM per context on q leaves of a full binary broadcaster tree gives a single canonical EB map with per-observable Dirichlet loss <=2*ceil(log2 q)*<H,(I-Phi)H>. One context can be measured directly and fixed exactly.
assumptions: a known partition of the tested family into q mutually commuting contexts
claims.status: direct internal consequence of the score identity and measurement refinement
claims.novelty_boundary: Exact context reuse is a restricted family result; it gives no approximate-context theorem for arbitrary growing noncommuting families.
claims.costs: For q>=2, q receivers and q-1 broadcaster calls, height <=ceil(log2 q), and at most d^q raw outcomes; q=1 uses direct dephasing and no broadcaster. Statistical acquisition, context identification and apparatus error are not included.
claims.falsifier: A failure of the common-PVM refinement score for an observable in one context.
claims.next_gate: Test approximate commuting/context covers with explicit normalized-HS rounding losses and tuple-size dependence.

claims.statement: The C4-Q3 scalar spectral-profile right side does not uniformly dominate the earlier equal-depth right side across admissible self-compatible channels: convex mixtures of computational dephasing and the universal qudit cloner have diagonal gaps tending to zero while Tr_HS(G) stays positive, making 2[1+log2(T/g)] unbounded on those modes at fixed d.
assumptions: Phi_t=t*Delta+(1-t)*C_d with both channels supplied self-broadcasters
claims.status: proved analytic non-domination example; it is not a counterexample to the C4 factor-2 conjecture or to the existence of a stronger comparator
claims.novelty_boundary: The example only compares guaranteed RHS profiles. The mixture still has a factor-2 EB comparator by convexly mixing the dephasing comparator and the cloner Haar comparator.
claims.costs: Analytic family; no computation. Universal cloner/dephasing broadcasters exist by their definitions; their convex mixture is a broadcaster for the channel mixture.
claims.falsifier: An error in the cloner eigenvalue, mixture spectrum, or WT profile evaluation.
claims.next_gate: Keep WT classified as a Pareto profile rather than a uniformly sharper bound.
